canonical_title: Fire protection of structure, controls, and other parts

versions.title_at_revision: Fire protection of structure, controls, and other parts
versions.text: Each part of the structure, controls, rotor mechanism, and other parts essential to a controlled landing that would be affected by powerplant fires must be fireproof or protected so they can perform their essential functions for at least 5 minutes under any foreseeable powerplant fire conditions.
